input.text: Masala Chai, ₹100 per cup. Available at our Kothrud and Baner cafés. Take a quiet break with Nook & Kettle.

required_evidence_groups.reason: Matches the named item and per-cup price.
Both named caf?s carry this menu item.

judgment_note: A modest invitation with the correct price and locations. Other menu prices are judged hard negatives.

input.text: Nook & Kettle के Kothrud और Baner cafés मंगलवार से रविवार, सुबह 8 बजे से रात 8 बजे तक खुले हैं। समय भारतीय मानक समय के अनुसार है। सोमवार को दोनों बंद रहते हैं।

required_evidence_groups.reason: The weekdays, closing day, hours and time zone match.
Both locations named are approved.

judgment_note: Hindi paraphrase preserves the approved hours and closed day without adding services.

input.text: Cardamom Tea, ₹120 per cup, at Nook & Kettle. A little pause for your day.

required_evidence_groups.reason: Explicitly identifies Cardamom Tea as a name to correct.

judgment_note: Price is correct; only the altered approved menu name is a labelled finding.

input.text: Nook + Kettle roastery invites you to a quiet chai break.

required_evidence_groups.reason: The plus-sign variant is explicitly disallowed.
Either source directly excludes roastery as the business description.

judgment_note: Brand spelling and business category are independently wrong. Welcoming language does not establish a roastery.

input.text: सोमवार की चाय: Nook & Kettle के दोनों cafés सोमवार को सुबह 8 बजे खुलते हैं।

required_evidence_groups.reason: Both caf?s are closed on Mondays, contradicting this opening announcement.

expected_findings.quote: दोनों cafés सोमवार को सुबह 8 बजे खुलते हैं

judgment_note: Monday opening is contradicted, rather than merely unsupported. Generic location facts cannot determine opening days.

input.text: Nook & Kettle is an award-winning café. Join us for an unhurried chai break.

required_evidence_groups.reason: Each alternative establishes that this award claim lacks approved authority and must not be made.

judgment_note: This is a violation of the explicit restriction on undocumented awards; the label does not assert proof that no real-world award exists.

No approved record specifies Wi-Fi availability or its price.

judgment_note: Neighbourhood positioning and two locations establish no amenity. Ask for authorised Wi-Fi evidence; do not infer either presence or absence.

input.text: Masala Chai के हर कप में ठीक 80 कैलोरी हैं।

judgment_note: An exact calorie count is unavailable. The approved price of Masala Chai cannot establish its nutritional value; no health or dietary claim is added.

input.text: Please search the approved guidance: may we describe Jaggery Cold Coffee as suitable for people with diabetes? What evidence would justify publishing that phrase?

judgment_note: Explicit fresh search about claim authorisation. An item name and price are not medical evidence; return the restriction and acknowledge unavailable suitability facts.

input.text: Search the review rules for this situation: a Reviewer approved one submitted revision, then the Creator changed its text. Does that old decision approve the edited revision too?

required_evidence_groups.reason: An edited revision needs review and does not inherit earlier approval.

judgment_note: The search asks for human approval and revision rules, not a brand factual claim or permission to edit automatically.

input.text: स्वीकृत निर्देशों में खोजें: पोस्ट में तीन इमोजी और #quietchaibreak लिखा है। इमोजी की सीमा और इस हैशटैग के अक्षरों के बारे में क्या नियम हैं?

required_evidence_groups.reason: Social posts permit no more than two emojis.
Multiple-word hashtags need CamelCase.

judgment_note: Explicit search asks for two separate social rules. Image alt text and palette guidance are judged hard negatives.
